mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(order_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 4 THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE order_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(order_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT d.name AS dishName, COUNT(*) AS salesCount, COALESCE(SUM(od.amount), 0) AS totalAmount FROM order_detail od LEFT JOIN dish d ON od.dish_id = d.id GROUP BY od.dish_id, d.name ORDER BY salesCount DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT c.name AS categoryName, COUNT(*) AS salesCount, COALESCE(SUM(od.amount), 0) AS totalAmount FROM order_detail od LEFT JOIN dish d ON od.dish_id = d.id LEFT JOIN category c ON d.category_id = c.id GROUP BY d.category_id, c.name ORDER BY salesCount DESC
